exceptions.justification: After the composition-test ownership audit, this class is the retained cross-subsystem TUI composition suite; focused subsystem behavior belongs in focused test modules and this baseline may not silently grow.

The compatibility facade still coordinates several focused editor owners through one controller class; new feature behavior belongs in those focused owners and this direct-method baseline may not silently grow.

The shared operation-lifecycle facade remains the composition point for focused playback, conflict, acceptance, and worker-event owners; new responsibilities must stay in focused owners and this baseline may not silently grow.

The Japanese/English word-list document was extracted into tui_rendering_dictionary_list.py for Issue #263. The remaining related Dictionary menu, import/review, filter, entry, and detail document dispatcher still spans 265 lines; this is a reviewed, reduced baseline, not a license to add unrelated rendering responsibilities.
